_comment: Machine-specific values for speedtest.py. A key X with a sibling 'X__GUESS' holds a value that was NOT verified against the target machine (reason in the sibling). Placeholders: {name} = other values of 'paths' / per-call variables; $VAR = environment variable; '~' = home. See README.md.

paths.mastodon_exe__GUESS: install location unknown. The shipped binary is bin/MASTODON (ELF x86-64); it is stored WITHOUT the executable bit in the zip we have, so you probably need: chmod +x bin/MASTODON
paths.mastodon_wrapper__GUESS: the binary links libX11/libGLX/libOpenGL; on a headless server without these libraries or a display, try ["xvfb-run", "-a"] (not verified).
paths.mastodon_root__GUESS: must be the folder containing bin/ systems/ tools/ (docs QuickStart: MASTODON_FOLDER = root of the install).
paths.infinigen_dir__GUESS: was ~/ig in WSL on the dev machine; the target checkout location is unknown.
paths.python__GUESS: interpreter of the Infinigen env that has bpy, gin and infinigen installed (was micromamba env 'ig' on the dev machine).
paths.conda_prefix__GUESS: only used for LD_LIBRARY_PATH below (the dev scripts exported $CONDA_PREFIX/lib).

mastodon.LD_LIBRARY_PATH__GUESS: the zip ships no bundled .so files (only bin/MASTODON and bin/ModelViewer), so this only matters if you add libraries next to the binary.
mastodon.BELLHOP_PATH__GUESS: only needed for Bellhop signal/propagation models; this test uses propagation.model = Geometric, so it is unset. Set it to the folder with the bellhop executable if a run complains about Bellhop.

infinigen.gin_install_dir__GUESS: true for the dev checkout (git edac8171); gin resolves -g files BY STEM from this folder, so the three assets/gin/*.gin files are copied there (nothing else in the checkout is touched).
infinigen.cuda_device_args__GUESS: Terrain.device is a gin-configurable argument of infinigen.terrain.core.Terrain (default 'cpu', lib/<device>/ must exist, i.e. the CUDA terrain libraries must have been built). Value 'cuda' is not verified; the WSL checkout only had terrain/lib/cpu.

prod.map__GUESS: map extent/resolution of the old 'production' run (76 s, 8.6 GB) were not recorded; this is a flat 32 x 13 m map at the patch resolution (2.5 cm) with the Infinigen patch pasted at x = 10 m. Pings, range and sonar are as specified. Peak RAM will differ from 8.6 GB if the old map was finer.
prod.threads__GUESS: calc.num_threads; 0 may mean 'all cores' (docs ConfigParams) but is untested; 4 is the value used in the dev runs.

concurrency.threads_policy__GUESS: 'divide' sets calc.num_threads = max(1, cores // N) per job so the machine is not oversubscribed; 'keep' leaves the profile value.
